title: A snack now or later
hook: Two stated cases: explore the timing in a stated temptation model.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the timing in a stated temptation model affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Advantage, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the timing in a stated temptation model in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
keyState: Both question and changed cases computed; both parameter/result witnesses retained.

claims.text: A toy model values immediate 7 normally, but delayed 10 after 1 periods as Beta 0.6 times Delta 1 to the delay. What is delayed minus immediate value?
